description: FileMyPublication's all-in price to complete New York LLC publication in a county (both newspapers for six weeks, the State filing fee and our service fee) and the newspapers designated there. In Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens and the Bronx the County Clerk assigns the papers, so the price is quoted once the Clerk names them.

county.description: The New York county named in the LLC's Articles of Organization, e.g. 'Albany', 'Nassau', 'Brooklyn' or 'Kings'. Borough names are accepted.

name: get_county_publication_cost
title: LLC publication cost by county
